item.title: Sea Cliff students participate in community culmination
item.description: Second-grade students at Sea Cliff School participated in a community culmination event on Friday, Jan. 30, showcasing an interdisciplinary unit focused on how communities function. During the event, each second-grade class created a miniature town inside its classroom. item.title: Great Neck Park District holds 2026 Snowman Showdown
item.description: After last week’s snowfall, the Great Neck Park District invited residents to put their creativity to work with its 2026 Snowman Showdown. Participants submitted photos of their snowmen for a chance to win prizes across three categories. item.title: Indian citizen extradited to Nassau pleads guilty to manslaughter stemming from 2005 Hicksville crash
item.description: An Indian citizen, who was extradited to Nassau County in September 2025 to face indictment charges for a high-speed crash on Old Country Road in Hicksville in April 2005 that killed a 44-year-old father and husband, pleaded guilty on Friday, Feb. 6, Nassau County District Attorney Anne Donnelly announced.
